elder.name: Elder Sora
lines: Ah, a young ninja! I have been expecting you.
Our village needs a hero, and you carry the name Mega-Ninja.
Look around the village, then come back and see me. Your journey begins soon.
repeatLines: Walk with courage, young ninja.

farmer.name: Farmer
lines: Welcome to the farm! The soil here is perfect for wheat.
Take these seeds. Stand next to a dirt plot, face it, and press Space (or the A button) to plant.
Fill your watering can at the pump, then water what you plant. A blue drop means a plant is thirsty. Dark soil means it has been watered. A yellow sparkle means it is ready to pick.
Beware those pesky rabbits, digging holes! Throw them out of the garden, if you can catch them! Face one and press F to pick it up, then press F again to throw it.
farmer.ask: I could use {amount} {item}. Bring it to me and I will pay {reward} gold.
farmer.notEnough: You have {have} of the {amount} {item} I need. Come back when you have them.
farmer.thanks: That is just what I needed! Here is your {reward} gold.
farmer.nextAsk: Now I need {amount} {item}. I will pay {reward} gold.
farmer.freeSeeds: Out of seeds? Take a few. I keep spares for this.
repeatLines: The fields are coming along. Come back soon.
farmer.ready: Is that {amount} {item} I see? Wonderful! Will you sell it to me for {reward} gold?

villager.name: Villager
lines: Oh no! The road south is buried under a landslide!
However will we dig all this up? It is a mountain of a problem... well, a hill. A very big hill.
Somebody will have to find a shovel.
repeatLines: Still no shovel? Rabbits dig holes all day. Maybe the ones on the farm know where to find one.

landslide_cleared: You did it! The road is open again. Thank you, hero!

lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
lines: Well, look at that. A ninja in my forest! Mind the branches.
Trees grow back, but they will not chop themselves. Take this axe. Face a tree and press Space to swing.
Axes wear out, mind. When it breaks, I can fix it for a bit of wood, or the market sells new ones.
lumberjack.ask: I can always use {amount} {item}. I will pay {reward} gold.
lumberjack.thanks: Fine, honest timber! Here is your {reward} gold.
lumberjack.nextAsk: Next I need {amount} {item}. That is {reward} gold.
lumberjack.menu: What can I do for you?
lumberjack.broken: That axe of yours is done for. I can fix it for some wood, or you can buy a new one at the market.
lumberjack.spare: No axe, no wood, no coin? Take this old spare. It will not last, but it will get you some timber. Then bring me the wood.
repeatLines: Chop away.

shopkeeper.name: Shopkeeper
lines: Welcome to my stall! Seeds, tools, and a few things you cannot find anywhere else.
Bring gold and I will bring the goods.
repeatLines: Welcome back! What are you buying?

miner.name: Miner
lines: Welcome to the quarry! Every rock here hides something. Grey ones are plain stone, but you will find copper, and if you are lucky, gems.
Swing a pickaxe at a rock to break it. The harder the rock, the more swings it takes. Rocks grow back in a different colour.
See that big cave up north? Rumbling started in there a while back. Something is not right. I would not go in. Not yet.
repeatLines: Back at the rocks, eh?
miner.menu: Is that pickaxe worn out? I can fix it for you. Just bring me some stone.
miner.nothing: Your pickaxe is in fine shape. Come back when it gets worn, and I will fix it for a few stones.

sensei.name: Sensei
lines: Ah, a ninja who farms. Now that is rare. Every ninja should know the way of the blade, even one who grows wheat.
But I do not hand a sword to just anyone. A true blade begins as honest wood. Show me you can work.
sensei.ask: I could use {amount} {item}. I will pay {reward} gold.
sensei.notEnough: I need {amount} {item}. You have {have}. Keep at it.
sensei.thanks: Well done. Here is your {reward} gold.
sensei.nextAsk: When you are ready, bring me {amount} {item}. I will pay {reward} gold.

treant.name: Gnarl
lines: Thank you again, little ninja. The forest feels light again.
repeatLines: The sun is warm and my roots are quiet. Thank you.
Keep the lantern close. The deep cave is no place to be without a light.

cavesign.name: Sign
lines: DANGER! Unstable cave. Bring a light.
repeatLines: DANGER! Unstable cave. Bring a light.

treant_defeated: The cave mouth is just north of here. Watch out for bats!

wanderer.name: Wanderer
lines: Just stretching my legs. I never stay in one place for long.
If you ever see a rabbit near the farm, that is not my fault.
repeatLines: Nice day for a walk, isn't it?

sealeddoor.name: Stone Door
lines: A huge stone door, carved with a ninja crest.
Beneath it are four sockets: a ruby, a sapphire and an emerald, and a round crest in the middle.
repeatLines: The stone door is sealed tight. Four sockets wait below the crest.

sealeddooropen.name: Stone Door
lines: The door stands open. A cold wind blows up from the deep.
repeatLines: The passage leads down into the Crystal Caverns.

granite.name: Granite
lines: Granite is sorry for the rockfall. Granite is very glad the voice is gone.
repeatLines: Granite likes pickaxes now. They tickle.
Say hi to the bats for Granite. They are not so bad.

crystalnote.name: Torn Note
lines: A scout's note, half buried in glittering dust:
"Sensei - the princess came through here three nights ago, carrying the Moon Crest."
"The bats down here serve a Queen who sleeps in the roost to the south. Something whispers in her dreams. Do not wake her."
repeatLines: "...the princess went on alone. Find her. - a worried scout"

nooksign.name: Cold Draft
lines: A cold draft seeps through a crack in the crystal wall. You hear faint, strange music behind it.
repeatLines: The crack in the wall is too dim to see through. A brighter light might show the way.

hexsmith.name: Hexsmith
lines: Heh heh... a customer with a lantern. Not many find my little corner of the dark.
I forge weapons nobody else would dare to. Bring me gold and glow crystals, and I will make you something special.
hexsmith.offer: Today I could forge {name}: {desc}. It takes time. Come back after you have wandered off, and it will be waiting.
hexsmith.ordered: Deal! The forge is already glowing. Go on, wander off... and come back later.
hexsmith.working: Patience! The {name} is still cooling. Leave the market and come back, and it will be ready.
hexsmith.ready: Ah, there you are! Your {name} is ready. Handle it with care... it bites.
hexsmith.done: I have nothing finer left to forge for you. You carry my best work.
hexsmith.farewell: Heh heh. The dark will wait.
repeatLines: Back again? Let us see what I can forge for you.

hexcreature.name: Critter Seller
lines: Psst! Treats for little friends. Furry ones, flappy ones, glowy ones. All of them love a snack.
repeatLines: Treats for your little friends?

hexcharm.name: Charm Seller
lines: Shiny things! I pay well for gems and glow crystals. Better than the daytime market, hee hee.
repeatLines: Got any sparkle for me?

closedstall.name: Sign
lines: This stall is closed. A brewing pot bubbles inside. "Back soon. - The Brewer"
repeatLines: Closed. Something purple is bubbling inside.

hexcust1.name: Hooded Shopper
lines: I came for a lucky charm. The seller says all her charms are a little bit haunted.
repeatLines: Haunted charms are the best kind.

hexcust2.name: Cloaked Traveler
lines: Shh. Do not tell the daylight folk about this place. They would want a discount.
repeatLines: Our secret.

hexcust3.name: Little Witch
lines: My pet bat has no name yet. Do you have any ideas?
Everyone says friends are better when you pick the name yourself.
repeatLines: Maybe I will call her Biscuit.

hexcust4.name: Gloomy Shopper
lines: I heard a princess passed through here, asking about a Moon Crest.
She did not buy anything. She just looked sad and kept going.
repeatLines: Tell her I said hello, if you find her.

peaksign.name: Sign
lines: SNOWY PEAKS. Beware the Yeti in the den to the north. Frostberries grow on the bushes.
repeatLines: The Yeti lives north, up the stone path.

icehermit.name: Old Hermit
lines: Brrr... a visitor! I have not seen anyone up here since the princess.
She stopped by three days ago, looking for the Sunken Ruins across the frozen lake.
The ice is far too thin to cross on plain boots, though. The Yeti has the only pair of Frost Boots, and he has been in a foul mood.
repeatLines: Frost Boots, from the Yeti in the den to the north. He is not himself lately.
Take care, the ice has no mercy.

yeti_defeated: You beat the Yeti? Bless my beard! Now the lake is yours to cross.
Follow the thin ice east. The ruins gate is on the far shore.

ruinsgate.name: Ruined Gate
lines: An old gate of green stone, half sunk in the snow. Faint carvings show a princess and a crescent crest.
It does not budge yet...
repeatLines: The old gate will not budge yet. (To be continued)

ruinssign.name: Worn Stone
lines: The letters are worn, but you can read: "THREE RUNES WAKE THE INNER DOOR. THE GUARDIAN SLEEPS BEYOND."
repeatLines: Three runes wake the inner door.

runestone.name: Rune Stone
lines: A rune stone, cold and dark. You press your hand against it.
repeatLines: The rune is dark.

runestoneon.name: Rune Stone
lines: The rune glows a steady, watery green.
repeatLines: The rune glows a steady, watery green.

ruinsdoor.name: Inner Door
lines: A heavy stone door with three glowing slots. Three rune stones in the ruins must wake it.
repeatLines: Three runes wake this door.

ruinsdooropen.name: Inner Door
lines: The door stands open. Water drips somewhere beyond.
repeatLines: The way to the guardian is open.

princessnote.name: Princess's Note
lines: A note pinned under a smooth stone, in careful, royal handwriting:
"I split the Moon Crest in two so the dark one could never take it all. I left one half here with the guardian, under the old waves."
"The other half I carry to the desert market, where the caravans trade. If you are reading this, you are brave. Please hurry. - P."
repeatLines: "...to the desert market. Please hurry. - P."

desertsign.name: Sign
lines: THE GREAT DESERT. The bazaar lies far to the east. Beware the scorpions, and the pit to the south-east.
repeatLines: The bazaar is east. The Scorpion King's pit is south-east. Do not go unprepared.

bazaarsign.name: Sign
lines: THE DESERT BAZAAR. Armor, treats and gems. Follow the red rug.
repeatLines: The Desert Bazaar is just ahead.

bzsmith.name: Armorsmith
lines: Welcome, traveller, to the only armor stall for a hundred miles of sand.
Bring me gold and sunstones from the desert rocks, and I will craft you armor fit for a hero.
bzsmith.offer: Today I could craft {name}: {desc}. Good armor takes time. Come back after you have wandered off, and it will be ready.
bzsmith.ordered: Excellent! Go on, explore the dunes, and come back later.
bzsmith.working: Patience, friend! The {name} is still cooling. Leave the bazaar and come back, and it will be ready.
bzsmith.ready: Ah, there you are! Your {name} is finished. Wear it with pride!
bzsmith.done: I have no finer armor left to craft. You wear my best work.
bzsmith.farewell: The sun will wait for you.
repeatLines: Back again? Let us see what armor I can craft for you.

bzspice.name: Treat Seller
lines: Treats from every land! Carrots, herbs, crystals, berries, seaweed and cactus fruit. Something for every little friend.
repeatLines: Treats for your little friends?

bzgem.name: Gem Trader
lines: Gems! Sunstones! I pay the best prices in the whole bazaar.
repeatLines: Got any shiny things for me?

princess.name: Princess
lines: Oh! You made it. You must be the ninja who followed my notes.
I have been hiding in this tent. The dark whisper still hunts me.
I split the Moon Crest in two so it could never take both halves. The Scorpion King took the half I carried. He wears it in his pit, south-east of here.
Please, if you can... beat him and bring it back. The whisper has made him furious.
repeatLines: The Scorpion King wears the other half in his pit, south-east of here. Be careful.

scorpionking_defeated: You did it! You have both halves! Hold them together...
The Moon Crest is whole again. See how it glows? It points north, past the snowy peaks, to where the moon touches the mountain.
Take this Waystone Charm too. Touch the glowing waystones wherever you go, then open your bag and use the charm to travel back to any of them.
That is where the dark whisper sleeps. We will go together, when you are ready. (To be continued)

bzcust1.name: Camel Driver
lines: My camel will not walk past the armor stall. He is afraid of his own reflection.
repeatLines: Do not tell him.

bzcust2.name: Spice Merchant
lines: Cactus fruit is sweeter on the road than in the bazaar. Do not ask me why.
repeatLines: It is true.

bzcust3.name: Traveler
lines: I heard the princess is staying in the far stall, the one with the crown on the sign.
repeatLines: Say hello for me.

bzcust4.name: Little Trader
lines: A friend followed me all the way here. I named her Biscuit. She is a very good lizard.
repeatLines: Biscuit says hello.

waystone.name: Waystone
lines: A tall stone, cold and quiet.
repeatLines: A tall stone, cold and quiet.

waystoneon.name: Waystone
lines: The waystone glows softly. It remembers you.
repeatLines: The waystone glows softly. A Waystone Charm can bring you back here.

schoolsign.name: Sign
lines: NINJA SCHOOL. Acceptance by Moon Crest only.
Grow. Befriend. Fight. Then come. (The sensei says the Moon Crest is the proof.)
repeatLines: NINJA SCHOOL. Acceptance by Moon Crest only.

headmaster.name: Headmaster
lines: The Moon Crest! You carried it all this way. You have grown food, made friends and faced bosses. That is the life experience a ninja needs.
Here is your acceptance letter. Look around: kitchen, potion lab, library, sparring hall, the dorms, and the garden out back.
repeatLines: Welcome back, student.
headmaster.needLine: Finish the first-year classes and the stairs will open for you. Still to do:
okLines: You have done every first-year class! Cooked, brewed, read and sparred.
The stairs in the hall are open. Upstairs are the Pet Dojo and the Enchanting Workshop.
upperLines: The stairs are open to you. Upstairs, the Pet Dojo teaches friends to fight. The Enchanting Workshop opens soon.

cook.name: Cook
lines: Welcome to the school kitchen! Bring me what you grow and I will cook something that heals.
repeatLines: Welcome to the school kitchen! Bring me what you grow and I will cook something that heals.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
lines: Herbs, berries and a little gem dust. That is all a good potion needs.
repeatLines: Herbs, berries and a little gem dust. That is all a good potion needs.

gardensign.name: Sign
lines: SCHOOL GARDEN. Please do not feed the pond.
The barn is at the end of the path. The animals there are happy as they are, but they love snacks.
repeatLines: SCHOOL GARDEN. Please do not feed the pond.
The barn is at the end of the path. The animals there are happy as they are, but they love snacks.

sparmaster.name: Sparring Master
lines: So you want to fight like a ninja. Good. Footwork first, sword second, ego never.
Hit the practice dummies with your sword (J). Every 10 good hits is one lesson. Pass 5 lessons and come back to me.
repeatLines: You have passed my class. Come and practice any time.
sparmaster.progress: Lessons complete: {n} of {total}. Keep hitting the dummies. Ten hits is one lesson.
passLines: Five lessons. Your stance is solid and your cuts are clean.
You pass! Your sword will hit harder from now on. Go and prove it.

dummy.name: Dummy
lines: A straw training dummy. It has been hit a lot and never complains.
repeatLines: A straw training dummy. It has been hit a lot and never complains.

librarian.name: Librarian
lines: Shh! Welcome to the library. Take any book you like and read it where it stands.
Read every book and I will have something for you.
repeatLines: You have read it all. I have nothing left to teach you. Well, maybe a few more volumes next year.
librarian.progress: Books read: {n} of {total}. There is a surprise when you have read them all.
doneLines: You read every single book! Nobody has ever done that.
Here is something better than a bookmark: a stronger heart. Knowledge is good for you.

book1.name: Book
lines: "A Ninja's Guide to Not Falling Off Things"
Chapter 1: Look down. Chapter 2: Do not look down. Chapter 3: You have fallen off something. See Chapter 1.
repeatLines: "A Ninja's Guide to Not Falling Off Things"
Chapter 1: Look down. Chapter 2: Do not look down. Chapter 3: You have fallen off something. See Chapter 1.

book2.name: Book
lines: "Cooking With Fire (And Other Mistakes)"
Rule one: a burnt pumpkin is still a pumpkin. Rule two: it is not. The Ninja Feast needs one treat from every land.
repeatLines: "Cooking With Fire (And Other Mistakes)"
Rule one: a burnt pumpkin is still a pumpkin. Rule two: it is not. The Ninja Feast needs one treat from every land.

book3.name: Book
lines: "The Secret Life of Rabbits"
Rabbits love carrots, but every creature has a favourite treat. Face them and offer it. The patient ninja gets a friend.
repeatLines: "The Secret Life of Rabbits"
Rabbits love carrots, but every creature has a favourite treat. Face them and offer it. The patient ninja gets a friend.

book4.name: Book
lines: "Bats Are Just Tiny Dragons With Opinions"
They live in dark caves and dislike being called cute. A crystal lantern helps. Their queen is not as nice as she looks.
repeatLines: "Bats Are Just Tiny Dragons With Opinions"
They live in dark caves and dislike being called cute. A crystal lantern helps. Their queen is not as nice as she looks.

book5.name: Book
lines: "Ice, Ice, Ninja"
The thin ice at the Snowy Peaks will not hold you. A pair of frost boots, made from frostberries, will.
repeatLines: "Ice, Ice, Ninja"
The thin ice at the Snowy Peaks will not hold you. A pair of frost boots, made from frostberries, will.

book6.name: Book
lines: "Moon Crest Mysteries"
The crest came in two halves, one from the cold and one from the deep. Whole, it points north, to where the moon touches the mountain.
repeatLines: "Moon Crest Mysteries"
The crest came in two halves, one from the cold and one from the deep. Whole, it points north, to where the moon touches the mountain.

book7.name: Book
lines: "101 Uses for a Shovel"
1. Digging. 2. Digging again. 3. Moving a landslide. 4. Hitting a rock. (Not recommended.) 5. Digging.
repeatLines: "101 Uses for a Shovel"
1. Digging. 2. Digging again. 3. Moving a landslide. 4. Hitting a rock. (Not recommended.) 5. Digging.

book8.name: Book
lines: "Enchanting for Beginners, Volume 1 of 12"
Volume 1 only explains how to hold the book. Volumes 2 to 12 are in the Enchanting Workshop upstairs. Gems and scrolls can add power to a weapon or armor.
repeatLines: "Enchanting for Beginners, Volume 1 of 12"
Volume 1 only explains how to hold the book. Volumes 2 to 12 are in the Enchanting Workshop upstairs. Gems and scrolls can add power to a weapon or armor.

student1.name: Student
lines: I am studying to be a ninja. Today I learned how to stand very still. It is harder than it looks.
Now I am practicing standing very still near the cook.
repeatLines: I am studying to be a ninja. Today I learned how to stand very still. It is harder than it looks.
Now I am practicing standing very still near the cook.

student2.name: Student
lines: The sparring master said I have good form. I think he says that to everyone.
repeatLines: The sparring master said I have good form. I think he says that to everyone.

student3.name: Student
lines: I hear you came all the way here with the Moon Crest! Everyone is talking about you.
repeatLines: I hear you came all the way here with the Moon Crest! Everyone is talking about you.

student4.name: Student
lines: The potions here taste awful, but they work. Mostly.
repeatLines: The potions here taste awful, but they work. Mostly.

student5.name: Student
lines: Shh, I am reading. Well, I am pretending to read. The books are very long.
repeatLines: Shh, I am reading. Well, I am pretending to read. The books are very long.

student6.name: Student
lines: The garden is my favourite part of the school. I have named every flower.
repeatLines: The garden is my favourite part of the school. I have named every flower.

sleeper1.name: Sleepy Student
lines: Zzz... five more minutes... zzz...
repeatLines: Zzz... five more minutes... zzz...

sleeper2.name: Sleepy Student
lines: Mmm... I was not asleep. I was resting my eyes. Zzz...
repeatLines: Mmm... I was not asleep. I was resting my eyes. Zzz...

bed.name: Bed
lines: A soft bed. You take a short nap.
repeatLines: A soft bed. You take a short nap.

barnkeeper.name: Barn Keeper
lines: These animals live here and they are very well fed. You can pet them or give them a snack.
They are not for taming. They belong to the school. But they like visitors.
repeatLines: Say hello to the animals. They love snacks.

animal_rabbit.name: Barn Rabbit
lines: A rabbit twitches its nose at you.
repeatLines: A rabbit twitches its nose at you.
animal_rabbit.petLine: You scratch its ears. It thumps its foot happily.
fedLines: The rabbit does a little jump.

animal_moth.name: Barn Moth
lines: A big fluffy moth rests on a hay bale.
repeatLines: A big fluffy moth rests on a hay bale.
animal_moth.petLine: Its wings flutter. Dust sparkles in the air.
fedLines: The moth glows a little brighter.

animal_snowfox.name: Barn Fox
lines: A small white fox curls up in the hay.
repeatLines: A small white fox curls up in the hay.
animal_snowfox.petLine: It leans into your hand and yawns.

animal_sandlizard.name: Barn Lizard
lines: A sleepy lizard is sunning itself under a lamp.
repeatLines: A sleepy lizard is sunning itself under a lamp.
animal_sandlizard.petLine: It blinks slowly. It likes you.
fedLines: The lizard puffs out its chest.

animal_crab.name: Barn Crab
lines: A crab sits in a bucket of water, waving a claw.
repeatLines: A crab sits in a bucket of water, waving a claw.
animal_crab.petLine: It clicks its claws in a happy rhythm.
fedLines: The crab waves a claw at you.

upstairssign.name: Sign
lines: SECOND YEAR. Left: Pet Dojo. Right: Enchanting Workshop.
repeatLines: SECOND YEAR. Left: Pet Dojo. Right: Enchanting Workshop.

trainer.name: Pet Trainer
lines: Welcome to the Pet Dojo! A friend that has learned to fight is a good friend to have.
Your friend will never be hurt. If it gets tired it just rests a while. Train it with its favourite treats, and it can wear armor too.
Bring your friend along first: open the friends menu and choose Come with me.
repeatLines: Welcome to the Pet Dojo! A friend that has learned to fight is a good friend to have.
Your friend will never be hurt. If it gets tired it just rests a while. Train it with its favourite treats, and it can wear armor too.
Bring your friend along first: open the friends menu and choose Come with me.

enchanter.name: Enchanter
lines: Welcome to the Enchanting Workshop! Gems and scrolls hold a little magic. Set one into your weapon or armor and it is yours.
Each piece of gear has room for one enchantment. A new one replaces the old, and the old one comes back to you.
Ember Gems add damage, Ward Gems add defense, and the Swift Scroll makes your swings faster. The greater gems need a diamond.
repeatLines: Welcome to the Enchanting Workshop! Gems and scrolls hold a little magic. Set one into your weapon or armor and it is yours.
Each piece of gear has room for one enchantment. A new one replaces the old, and the old one comes back to you.
Ember Gems add damage, Ward Gems add defense, and the Swift Scroll makes your swings faster. The greater gems need a diamond.

student7.name: Student
lines: I tried to enchant my lunch. It glowed for an hour and then got very cold.
repeatLines: I tried to enchant my lunch. It glowed for an hour and then got very cold.

student8.name: Student
lines: Training pets is hard work. I trained a snail once. It is still in training.
repeatLines: Training pets is hard work. I trained a snail once. It is still in training.

wkshelf.name: Shelf
lines: Shelves of dusty scrolls. All of them say "volume 2" on the spine.
repeatLines: Shelves of dusty scrolls. All of them say "volume 2" on the spine.

student9.name: Student
lines: Did you hear the Pet Dojo trainer? He gave his own pet a tiny vest.
repeatLines: Did you hear the Pet Dojo trainer? He gave his own pet a tiny vest.

nightsign.name: Sign
lines: NIGHT BARN. Bring a light. These friends only come out after dark.
They love moonblooms and glowcaps, which only grow at night.
repeatLines: NIGHT BARN. Bring a light. These friends only come out after dark.
They love moonblooms and glowcaps, which only grow at night.

nightkeeper.name: Night Keeper
lines: Shh, the animals here are shy. They sleep all day and wake at dusk.
You cannot take them home, but out in the world you may find wild ones at night. Bring them a moonbloom or a glowcap.
repeatLines: Quietly now. Say hello to the night animals.

animal_owl.name: Barn Owl
lines: A round owl blinks slowly at you from a rafter.
repeatLines: A round owl blinks slowly at you from a rafter.
animal_owl.petLine: It lets out a soft hoot.
fedLines: It swallows it whole and hoots.
The owl ruffles its feathers happily.

animal_moonhare.name: Barn Hare
lines: A pale hare with a tiny crescent mark sits very still.
repeatLines: A pale hare with a tiny crescent mark sits very still.
animal_moonhare.petLine: Its nose twitches. It likes you.
fedLines: The hare does a quiet little hop.

animal_firefly.name: Barn Firefly
lines: A firefly drifts through the dark, glowing softly.
repeatLines: A firefly drifts through the dark, glowing softly.
animal_firefly.petLine: It lands on your finger for a moment.
fedLines: The firefly does a happy loop.

animal_bat.name: Barn Bat
lines: A small bat hangs upside-down, watching you.
repeatLines: A small bat hangs upside-down, watching you.

animal_shadow.name: Barn Sprout
lines: A little shadow sprout sways in the dark.
repeatLines: A little shadow sprout sways in the dark.
fedLines: The sprout glows a faint green.

tailor.name: Ninja Tailor
lines: Ninja outfits! Every ninja wears black, but a splash of colour says who you are.
Pick your colour. You can come back and change it any time.
repeatLines: Back for a new look?

fisher.name: Old Fisher
lines: Ho there, young ninja! Patience is a ninja skill, and fishing is the best way to practise it.
Take this rod. Face a pond, press Space to cast, and press Space AGAIN the moment the fish bites.
Then keep the marker inside the green bar to reel it in. Rare fish need more than one pull!
repeatLines: Any luck at the water today?
fisher.menu: What can I do for you?
tips: Some fish only come out at night. Others only in the daytime.
There are ponds in the school garden, here in the forest, and a frozen lake up in the Snowy Peaks.
Cook your catch at the Fish Grill in the school kitchen. And some friends love a fish treat!
Bring me wood and gold and I will build you a better rod: a longer bite window and a wider green zone.

grillcook.name: Angler Chef
lines: I am the Angler Chef! Bring me your catch and I will grill it into something that heals.
repeatLines: Fresh fish? Let me fire up the grill!

fishsign.name: Sign
lines: FISHING POND. Face the water with a rod and press Space.
repeatLines: FISHING POND. Face the water with a rod and press Space.

brewer.name: The Brewer
lines: Heh heh heh... the stall is open again! My cauldron has been bubbling all week.
The green one makes your feet fly. The yellow one lets you see in the dark, even without a big lantern.
The purple one does both. Drink them from your bag. They wear off, so use them well!
repeatLines: Back for more brew, little ninja?

tinker.name: Wandering Tinker
lines: Ha! A customer! I wander from market to market with a bag of spanners and a very small hammer.
Axe chipped? Pickaxe cracked? Shovel bent? I can fix any of them, right here, for gold or for materials.
And if you have spare wood or stone, I will happily buy it. Pine from these peaks is fine stuff.
repeatLines: Back again! Anything need a tune-up?
tinker.menu: What can I fix for you?
tinker.nothing: Your tools look fine to me, and you have nothing to sell. Come back when something is worn.

cavemaster.name: Surveyor Tam
lines: Oh! A visitor with a lantern. Perfect timing!
I am the Surveyor. I am supposed to draw a map of every chamber in these caves, but my knees gave out years ago.
Here is my offer: explore the whole cave for me. Eight chambers, from the Entrance Cavern all the way to the very back. A pickaxe will clear the blocked tunnels.
When you have seen every one, I will thank you properly. I will teach you to cook and to brew.
cavemaster.noneLine: You have not found any chambers yet. Go on in, and mind the bats!
cavemaster.progress: You have found {n} of {total} chambers. Keep exploring! Some tunnels are blocked by rocks.
teachLines: You found them all! Every single chamber, even the hidden one. My map is finished!
A deal is a deal. Listen close: cooking is just ingredients and a steady hand. Brewing is the same, with herbs and a little patience.
From now on you do not need the school cook or the alchemist. Open your bag and look for the COOK and BREW tabs. Pick a recipe and make it, anywhere you like.
The school will still do it for you if you are in a hurry. Thank you, friend!
repeatLines: Thank you again! My map looks wonderful. Enjoy your cooking and brewing.

cavechest.name: Chest
lines: The lid creaks open...
Treasure! The old miners hid it well. It is all yours.
repeatLines: The chest is empty now.

cavechestopen.name: Chest
lines: The chest is empty now.
repeatLines: The chest is empty now.
